name: How often should a team train for optimal results?
description: Aim for 3-5 team training sessions per week for optimal functional fitness results; adjust based on your fitness level and recovery needs.

mainEntity.name: How often should a team train for optimal results?

acceptedAnswer.text: For optimal results in functional fitness team training, a common recommendation is to attend 3-5 sessions per week, allowing for adequate recovery between workouts. The ideal frequency can be a decision factor based on your current fitness level, personal goals, and how your body adapts to the training load. Consistency is more important than intensity in the beginning, gradually increasing as your strength and endurance improve.
